metadata.name: trajectory-power-phase5-latent-rank-ladder
metadata.intent: Phase 5 latent-rank ladder (readiness item 3): at the chosen design point (rho = 0, n_samples = 1200, four stages, p_dmp = 0.1) measure how every statistic's operating characteristics respond to the retained PLS rank, and decide by a predeclared rule whether Phase 5 commits to stage-supervised double CV or to a fixed, predeclared rank. All four modes (magnitude, orientation, shape, translation) at effects 0/0.25/0.50/1.00; one design axis, evaluation.integration_params.forced_components in {null, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12}, where null is the cross-validated reference column; 100 replicates, 199 permutations, matched seeds with one shared zero-effect anchor per column.
notes: Same data, different measurement. The rank axis is an evaluation-namespace axis, so every column shares the primary matched-seed family and identical generator parameters with the baseline: at every replicate index the six columns evaluate the same generated dataset under different retained ranks. Differences between columns are measurement differences, not sampling differences, and rank_decision.json states the pairing. The pooled independent SE used by the rule is therefore conservative.

null is the baseline value of the rank axis and means 'key absent': the baseline column's evaluation parameters carry no forced_components key, so its cells are byte-identical (same ids and signatures) to a config without the design grid. It is the cross-validated column and the reference every forced rank is compared against; it also re-measures magnitude and shape at the chosen design point under CV, which the design-point report said Phase 5 must do.

Forced 3 is included on purpose. The CV column's selected rank ranges 2-4 with median 3 (= n_stages - 1) at this design point; without a forced-3 column any difference between CV and forced 4 would confound 'one more component' with 'no selection noise'. 'Fixed n_stages - 1' is also itself a candidate group-blind rule, so it must be measured to be adoptable. 12 is the top rung because the 2026-09-03 latent-rank probe saw no further change from 9 to 12, and the rule's parsimony clause can only reach a higher rung if every lower one fails.

The rank decision (acceptance.rank_decision) is advisory and predeclared, evaluated against the null column: a forced rank qualifies when it raises orientation/angle power at the top effect by more than 2 pooled MC SEs, keeps every statistic's zero-effect anchor within alpha + 2 SE, and lowers neither magnitude/delta nor shape/shape power at the top effect by more than 2 pooled SEs. Verdict keep_cv or adopt_fixed_rank with the smallest qualifying rank. Translation is not protected: it is a negative control covered by the anchor criterion and the baseline Type I target; its e > 0 cells are still reported in the ladder. Only group-blind rules are candidates (the geometry audit's caution: group-aware sizing voids the fixed-latent-space RRPP conditioning).

surgery_censoring is left at its default ('error'); enumeration rejects over-headroom cells before compute is spent. At rho = 0, p_dmp = 0.1, four stages, orientation saturates near e = 1.69 and translation near e = 2.00, so the 0.25-1.00 axis is realizable for every pool-limited mode. Do not copy the historical 'clamp' flag from the Phase 4 configs.

Cost. 6 columns x (1 anchor + 4 modes x 3 nonzero effects) = 78 power cells plus the two baseline Type I controls = 80 cells, 8,000 work units. The CV column costs about 56 s per unit on an EPYC 7662 core (design-point pilot, n = 1200, 199 permutations); forced columns skip the double CV and are cheaper. Budget roughly 120 EPYC core-hours; 100 single-CPU shards finish in about 1.5 h wall. Pin BLAS to one thread (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1).

Do not pass --n-jobs: the worker count enters the parameter signature and changes the realized permutation draws. Parallelize across shards. Run with --error-policy record so a forced rank that is infeasible on some replicate (the evaluator rejects rather than clamps) is recorded per column instead of aborting the shard; expected feasibility is min(~660 features, 1200 samples) >= 12 for every replicate.

The Phase 4 gate is disabled: this ladder chooses a rank rule, it does not gate Phase 5. Attribution diagnostics are off. The eigengap is a property of the configuration in the latent space and will differ across rank columns on identical data; read it per column as recorded, never as a baseline-geometry change.
